text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
O mortal, how does the wood of the vine surpass all other wood— the vine branch that is among the trees of the forest?
text_cn: “人子，树林中这棵葡萄树，到底有什么超越其他一切树木之处？

text_en: Is wood taken from it to make anything? Does one take a peg from it on which to hang any object?
text_cn: 岂能取它的木材制造用具，或者能取出它一根枝条，在上面悬挂器具？

text_en: It is put in the fire for fuel; when the fire has consumed both ends of it and the middle of it is charred, is it useful for anything?
text_cn: 只有投入火中焚烧；火焚烧了它的两端，中间也在焚烧；它还能有什么用途？

text_en: When it was whole it was used for nothing; how much less—when the fire has consumed it, and it is charred— can it ever be used for anything!
text_cn: 当它完整时，还不能作什么用具，何况经火燃烧焚化之后，岂不是更不能制造什么用具？

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give up the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 为此，吾主上主这样说：我怎样把树林中的葡萄树投入火中焚烧，也必怎样对待耶路撒冷的居民。

text_en: I will set my face against them; although they escape from the fire, the fire shall still consume them; and you shall know that I am the Lord , when I set my face against them.
text_cn: 我要翻脸打击他们：他们虽从火中逃出来，仍要为火焚烧。当我翻脸打击他们时，他们必承认我是上主。

text_en: And I will make the land desolate, because they have acted faithlessly, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 因为他们背信违约，我必使那地方变为荒野 —— 吾主上主的断语。”
